AT_Command.label: AT Command
AT_Command.description: Used to execute an AT command on a cellular modem

Command.label: Command
Command.description: The AT command to run. Example: AT+CREG? to query registration status

Response.label: Response
Response.description: Response to the AT command. Example: +CREG:0,5 If multiple lines are returned as the modem response, each line will be returned in a separate resource.

Status.label: Status
Status.description: Status of the command execution as returned by the modem. Typical values:OK ERROR

Timeout.label: Timeout
Timeout.description: Amount of time in seconds allowed for the modem to respond to the command.

Run.label: Run
Run.description: Executing this resource will cause the command to be sent to the modem. And the result to be populated using the Response (1) and Status (2) resources
